stories.s: Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the startup and its rivals.

techmeme.com: Source: AI training data startup Micro1's gross annual run rate grew from $100M to $500M in the past eight months, putting net annual run rate at $150M-$200M (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
